name: fraud-detector
intended_use: This model performs automated real-time transaction scoring to flag suspicious high-value payment transactions for downstream manual fraud investigation and automated risk-rule intervention.
training_data: Trained on aggregated behavioral features from the card_activity feature group (v1 source transactions), covering historical transaction amounts and card-present ratios, but limited to observed cardholder spending baselines without cross-merchant context.
limitations: As a single amount-threshold classifier, the model structurally cannot detect low-value card testing, rapid-fire velocity fraud, structured multi-transaction splits below the threshold, or compromised cards operating within normal transaction amounts.
ethical_considerations: False positives inconvenience and embarrass legitimate cardholders while temporarily denying access to funds, whereas false negatives result in direct financial losses borne by merchants and the issuing financial institution; high-value legitimate spenders may face disproportionate verification friction.
